synopsis: This documentary traces the development and flight-testing of the X-15 rocket-powered research aircraft. It covers earlier experimental aircraft, engineering challenges such as hypersonic heating and near-space control, pilot training, air launches, ground tracking, accidents and modifications, and the joint efforts of NASA, the military and industry. The film highlights X-15 research into high-speed aerodynamics, reentry and human flight near space, including flights reaching 67 miles in altitude and Mach 6.
